title: Reels trend report / Your dose of good vibes

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use a dominant field and a contrasting text accent to keep an illustrated message coherent.
strategic_value: A yellow field with violet lettering can make a busy Instagram illustration read as one campaign asset.
demonstration: A yellow vertical composition pairs a small report label, a beach illustration and the large phrase Your dose of good vibes.
practical_value: Keep the field continuous around detailed imagery and reserve the accent block for a key word.

content_islands.name: Illustrated scene
content_islands.spec: Set the beach illustration in the upper half beneath the report label.

content_islands.name: Headline block
content_islands.spec: Place the violet message below and reverse vibes from a violet rounded rectangle.

reference_purposes.Expression: Yellow, violet and the playful illustration establish a vivid character.
reference_purposes.Application: The example shows background color carrying both illustration and headline.
